sundai:fc:306.question: Doctors say meat and vegetables are a good _____ for a healthy diet.
sundai:fc:306.fullSentence: Doctors say meat and vegetables are a good model for a healthy diet.
sundai:fc:306.explanation: a model: 模範、型。a mode: 様式。

sundai:fc:307.question: Doctors recommended a natural _____ for his back pain.
sundai:fc:307.fullSentence: Doctors recommended a natural remedy for his back pain.

sundai:fc:308.question: She practices _____ every morning to calm her mind.
sundai:fc:308.fullSentence: She practices meditation every morning to calm her mind.

sundai:fc:309.question: Drink alcohol in _____ amounts, not too much.
sundai:fc:309.fullSentence: Drink alcohol in moderate amounts, not too much.

sundai:fc:310.question: You may need to _____ your plan slightly to fit the budget.
sundai:fc:310.fullSentence: You may need to modify your plan slightly to fit the budget.

sundai:fc:311.question: This hotel can _____ up to five hundred guests.
sundai:fc:311.fullSentence: This hotel can accommodate up to five hundred guests.
sundai:fc:311.explanation: accommodate: 収容する、対応する。

sundai:fc:312.question: Please dress _____ for the job interview.
sundai:fc:312.fullSentence: Please dress modestly for the job interview, choosing modest clothing.

sundai:fc:313.question: 「悪名高い」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:313.fullSentence: The area is notorious for its high crime rate.
sundai:fc:313.explanation: notorious: 悪名高い。recognize: 認識する。noble: 高貴な。

sundai:fc:314.question: It's important to _____ your own mistakes.
sundai:fc:314.fullSentence: It's important to recognize your own mistakes.

sundai:fc:315.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:315.question: He _____ chose to stay silent during the meeting.
sundai:fc:315.fullSentence: He deliberately chose to stay silent during the meeting.

sundai:fc:316.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:316.question: She gave an _____ explanation of the whole process.
sundai:fc:316.fullSentence: She gave an elaborate explanation of the whole process.
sundai:fc:316.explanation: elaborate: 念入りな、詳しく述べる。

sundai:fc:317.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:317.question: All employees must _____ to the company's dress code.
sundai:fc:317.fullSentence: All employees must conform to the company's dress code.

sundai:fc:318.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:318.question: This garden will _____ if you water it every day.
sundai:fc:318.fullSentence: This garden will flourish if you water it every day.
sundai:fc:318.explanation: flourish: 繁栄する。flour: 小麦粉。florist: 花屋。

sundai:fc:319.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:319.question: Small businesses can _____ even in a difficult economy.
sundai:fc:319.fullSentence: Small businesses can prosper even in a difficult economy.
sundai:fc:319.explanation: prosper: 繁栄する。desperate: 絶望的な、必死の。

sundai:fc:320.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:320.question: This is a _____ moment for the future of our company.
sundai:fc:320.fullSentence: This is a crucial moment for the future of our company.

sundai:fc:321.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:321.question: This technology represents a major _____ in medicine.
sundai:fc:321.fullSentence: This technology represents a major innovation in medicine.

sundai:fc:322.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:322.question: He felt _____ speaking in front of so many people.
sundai:fc:322.fullSentence: He felt awkward speaking in front of so many people.

sundai:fc:323.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:323.question: You should buy travel _____ before going abroad.
sundai:fc:323.fullSentence: You should buy travel insurance before going abroad.

sundai:fc:324.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:324.question: The government will _____ new policies next year.
sundai:fc:324.fullSentence: The government will implement new policies next year.

sundai:fc:325.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:325.question: There is _____ of food and water for everyone here.
sundai:fc:325.fullSentence: There is plenty of food and water for everyone here.

sundai:fc:326.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:326.question: Vitamin tablets are a good _____ to a balanced diet.
sundai:fc:326.fullSentence: Vitamin tablets are a good supplement to a balanced diet.

sundai:fc:327.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:327.question: The plane began to _____ high above the clouds.
sundai:fc:327.fullSentence: The plane began to soar high above the clouds.
sundai:fc:327.explanation: soar: 舞い上がる、急上昇する。startling: 驚くべき。

sundai:fc:328.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:328.question: Many politicians publicly _____ the terrorist attack.
sundai:fc:328.fullSentence: Many politicians publicly condemn the terrorist attack.
sundai:fc:328.explanation: condemn: 非難する。damn: のろう。

sundai:fc:329.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:329.question: The meeting was _____ due to unexpected circumstances.
sundai:fc:329.fullSentence: The meeting was prolonged due to unexpected circumstances.

sundai:fc:330.cat: 性格・様子を表す形容詞
sundai:fc:330.question: The novel vividly _____ life in the 19th century.
sundai:fc:330.fullSentence: The novel vividly depicts life in the 19th century.
